decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk fits the firm's core office furniture competence, has a dedicated page signalling commitment, and one year of results is too little to show a shortfall that would trigger search.
A chair family is central to a furniture maker's range and has prominent web presence, so with uncertain early results and some slack, management will keep it.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche, peripheral item whose results likely trail aspirations, but they are cheap to carry and still presented on their own page, so they are kept for now.
The sofa is only mentioned rather than featured, suggesting weak commitment and possibly underperformance, but one year is short and the evidence is too ambiguous to drop it yet.
A high standing table complements the office and contract range at low cost and has its own page, so management will keep it while results mature.
The rug collection is outside the core furniture business and could fall short of aspirations, but its dedicated presentation and links to the carpet-cushion line favour keeping it another year.
